title: Claude Artifact to review Characters
author: sOCkmONke
selftext:
This is not a one-shot game. I’m iterating through a project with Claude called Lunabara a moon colony sim with capybaras and this is an artifact of my workflow.

I wanted to share and discuss any useful tools/visualizations you have found working with AI.

I prompted it to let me review some character concepts ideas and was blown away at this artifact in response. I was expecting a 2D concept art sheet, but it created this interactive page that it modeled, rigged, animated, and created a web based test environment 🤯. 

The models it created are not great, but I would have loved this type of review process when making games professionally in a team. It would taken me a good chunk of time to have developed this interface and herd assets to review content.

Amaze.

https://claude.ai/artifact/MFGMTY3Y5EFk1taeqhgiBY

replies.author: sOCkmONke
replies.body:
Cool! I don’t have blender hooked up, so it’s great to see this process.

I think the benefit of having the review process as a claude artifact in house is that i can also review the assets in its own engine. For example i didn’t want it to build the whole game so it created a slice of the loop so i could review rendering passes with some settings i could tweak.
